title: Give instruments specific arrangement roles
summary: Community hypothesis: assigning each important instrument a concrete musical job may steer arrangements more effectively than adding broad mood adjectives.

build.target: Replace vague instrumentation lists with audible roles for each featured instrument.
requires: Known instrument list and arrangement context
inputs: Desired lead, bass, rhythm and counterpoint interactions
execute: Identify lead, supporting harmony, rhythmic propulsion, bass support and counterlines.
Describe instrument actions and interaction over time rather than listing instruments alone.
Reduce role conflicts and avoid specifying instruments that should not be audible.
If authorized, A/B test role language against an instrument-list baseline.
Record observed instrument presence and interplay; report missing roles.

applies_when: A song has all requested instruments but sounds cluttered.
Instrument lists yield ambiguous or generic arrangements.
avoid_when: An instrumental role is irrelevant to a solo unaccompanied recording.
The source is fixed audio where no generation controls exist.

operator: Changing words is not an enforceable instrumentation constraint.
For provider tests require approved credit cap.

stop_when: Role map is produced or a bounded audition completes.
Do not retry indefinitely for a perfect arrangement.

checks: Listener identifies whether requested parts and interactions are audible.
Compare results under the same model and conditions.
